5/G.goal: Explain the foundational definitions of augmented reality, virtual reality, and mixed reality, including the identifying characteristics of augmented reality, the difference between augmented and virtual reality, the reality-virtuality continuum, and the course's treatment of mixed reality as augmented reality.
5/G.achieves: Provides the learner with the basic XR terminology needed to follow later explanations of XR systems and to build toward understanding and implementing an XR system.

5/O1.goal: Explain the foundational definitions of augmented reality, virtual reality, and mixed reality, including the identifying characteristics of augmented reality, the difference between augmented and virtual reality, the reality-virtuality continuum, and the course's treatment of mixed reality as augmented reality.
5/O1.achieves: Gives the learner a common vocabulary and conceptual framework for AR, VR, and MR to use when studying later course topics on XR hardware, human factors, system development, and optimization.
